title: AtlasSnapshot
description: Canonical, immutable cockpit state reduced from an fcd journal plus declared plan/question/artifact records. This is the wire form of atlas.model.AtlasSnapshot.to_dict(). A skin renders a projection of this object and MUST NOT mutate it. Every item/stage node is grounded in a real fcd journal event; nodes with status 'planned' come only from a plan record and carry no executed model.

policy_version.description: Policy version this snapshot was rendered under. NOT necessarily the version any given item pinned at Open — see nodes[*].policy_version.

generated_at.description: Logical time the snapshot was produced, from the caller-supplied clock. Preserved verbatim; the reducer has no clock of its own.

capabilities.description: Default hierarchy (class -> specialist -> model), present even with an empty journal.

nodes.description: All work nodes (items and their stages) keyed by node id.

roots.description: Item node ids with no depends_on (top of the DAG).

store.description: Accepted artifact item ids (fcd store contents), sorted.

questions.description: All unresolved/resolved questions across the atlas.

parent.description: Item id for a stage node; null for an item node.

children.description: Stage node ids (for an item); empty for a stage.

policy_version.description: For an item, the version PINNED at Open — not the render version.

declared_model.description: Stage only: m_decl written by Bind (pre-norm).

executed_model.description: Stage only: m_exec written by Observe (pre-norm). Null on a planned/unobserved stage.

fault.description: Stage only: F1..F10 on a published fail-closed.

blocked.description: True iff this node carries at least one unresolved question. Blocks ONLY this node.

node_id.description: The exact node this question blocks. MUST exist in nodes.

runnable.description: Observed to be executable/openable, not merely present.

impact.description: Failure impact over item-node ids. observed/reachable/unknown are pairwise disjoint and together cover every item node. 'unknown' means NOT ASSERTED (neither failed nor a declared dependent of a failure) — it is not a safety claim.

observed.description: Items with a published fail-closed decision in the journal.

reachable.description: Non-observed items with a transitive depends_on path onto an observed failure.

unknown.description: Everything else. Absence of a claim, not a safe claim.
